entry.title: Welcome
entry.content:
¡Hola! I’m Aaron Roman, Co-Founder and Head of Data Engineering & AI at Danelfin, where we’re revolutionizing investment analysis through explainable artificial intelligence models.

What We’re Building at Danelfin

At Danelfin, we’ve developed an AI-based stock and ETF analysis platform that:

  • Rates investments on a 1-10 scale
  • Provides explainable AI to help users understand investment decisions
  • Predicts market performance for US and European stocks
  • Makes complex analysis accessible to retail investors
  • Leverages cutting-edge ML models for financial insights

We recently closed a €2 million funding round led by Nauta Capital, which validates our vision of making advanced investment tools available to everyone.

Let’s Connect

I’m always excited to connect with fellow developers, data scientists, and anyone passionate about the intersection of AI and finance.

Find me on:

  • LinkedIn - Professional updates and insights
  • Twitter - Tech thoughts and industry discussions
  • GitHub - Code and open-source contributions
